summary: Delta Air Lines filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5)) for an offering of senior unsecured notes, with principal amount, coupon and maturity left blank in this preliminary version. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes; joint book-running managers are BofA Securities, Citigroup, Deutsche Bank Securities, Goldman Sachs and Standard Chartered Bank. The notes rank pari passu with existing senior indebtedness and carry a 101% change-of-control repurchase right. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no equity or control event is involved. Watch pricing terms and any leverage impact.
